syntax_probe.note: py_compile output directory was not writable in the analysis sandbox; AST parsing was used without modifying sources.

findings.claim: Passive hypothesis evaluation can resolve a hypothesis from later idle thoughts generated by the same system. Keyword predictions use Jaccard overlap and sentiment predictions use simple direction-word polarity; successful match calls resolve(...,'confirmed') and process_hypothesis_outcome(..., success=True). Conversation text can also be used as passive evidence. Failed experimental tests are downgraded to passive after repeated failed experiment attempts.
findings.risk: A self-generated hypothesis can receive confirmation/reward from descendant self-generated text without independent intervention or external observation. This is useful internal consistency feedback but circular as scientific evidence.
findings.required_oracle: Every hypothesis resolution must carry evidence ancestry/class. SELF_GENERATED_PASSIVE_MATCH may update local salience/calibration but cannot count as independent support, Goodman replication or causal confirmation. Experiment failure must not silently become a lower-standard path to strong confirmation.

findings.claim: Relation predictions are evaluated by counting generic relation verbs such as talked/spoke/asked/told/laughed/argued/mentioned, while temporal/behavioral predictions use word-overlap heuristics and confidence adjustments.
findings.required_oracle: Hypothesis status must expose measurement operator and false-positive envelope. Lexical proxies cannot be promoted as mechanism evidence without matched nulls or explicit observation schema.

findings.claim: Collector ingests RSS, Reddit, ArXiv, HN, GitHub, web and optional 4chan material into the same data-point path. FourChan is stored under generic source_type='web'. KnowledgeGraph.ingest_data_point stores source provenance but has no credibility/reliability weighting field in the ingestion path and creates co_mentioned relations with fixed confidence 0.3 whenever entities co-occur, regardless of source class.
findings.constraint: This does not prove later article synthesis treats all sources equally; synthesizer applies additional filters/quality gates. The finding is scoped to raw graph ingestion/relation formation.
findings.required_oracle: Raw source ingestion must preserve source identity/credibility class and activation separately from truth. Co-mention from an untrusted source may create discoverable evidence ancestry but cannot directly become canonical relation confidence.

findings.claim: Non-preloaded synthesis filters 4chan/unapproved Reddit/junk, applies coherence and learned story gates, but preloaded story clusters explicitly skip those later filters because clustering is assumed to have established coherence. These presentation/synthesis gates occur after raw data points and graph co-mentions have already been ingested.
findings.required_oracle: Article quality gates must not retroactively upgrade raw graph truth. Preloaded-cluster bypass needs its own provenance/quality receipt; source trust and relation evidence remain independent of article publication.

findings.claim: Genesis sandbox uses temporary-directory/subprocess containment and network checks but shows no seccomp, namespaces, bwrap/firejail/chroot or setrlimit security boundary in the inspected source. This corroborates already recovered historical sandbox-limit findings rather than providing independent new evidence.
findings.required_oracle: Self-engineering experiments require external capability isolation; sandbox success is experiment execution evidence, not effect authority.

findings.claim: Pip agent is explicitly an on-demand robot companion HTTP service, not a permanent research daemon; it auto-shuts down after inactivity and exposes local activate/chat/task/status/memory endpoints.
findings.required_oracle: Do not count Pip companion behavior as autonomous research evidence or core FRANK cognitive architecture unless a current architecture contract explicitly retains it.

reuse.reason: Genesis/autonomy/research and LCME/research mechanisms are already represented in historical mappings. This shard adds epistemic-boundary/failure oracles and exact Drive identity.
